messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — PR #834 for docs: unified SDK snippets for streaming + retries + pagination in py/ts/go. Need a quick review and a tiny fix for TS signature. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 @Samir @Devon
Samir Patel: :eyes: looking. Quick Q — are we using the new streaming iterator API or the older callback style? Prefer idiomatic TS async iterators.
Devon Lee: I updated the py snippet to use async for + backoff. Pasted example below. Can someone sanity-check?
```python
async for chunk in client.stream_generate(prompt):
    if getattr(chunk, 'retry_after', None):
        await asyncio.sleep(chunk.retry_after)
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Jin Park: TS fix incoming — the old example used `client.stream()` with callback; should use `for await (const part of client.streamCompletion(...))` to show iterator + try/catch for retries. I'll push a small patch.
Samir Patel: Also add note about pagination: show pageToken pattern for embeddings and `limit` + `cursor` in examples. Short one-liner for both SDKs should do.
Maya Chen: Great. Also add a short comment about idempotency and deduping tokens when resuming streams — small paragraph under the streaming heading.
Devon Lee: One more: Go example needs to show proper context timeout and backoff. Draft:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
respCh, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
for r := range respCh { fmt.Print(r.Text) }
```
Pls check.
Jin Park: Pushed TS change + small README tweak. PR now has 3 commits. @Maya can you quick glance and merge if OK? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834/files
docs-bot: CI: docs lint passed on branch update/834 — 3 checks OK :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: reviewing now. If green I'll merge by EOD.
Samir Patel: If merged, can we add a short migration note in changelog v0.12.2? Folks following older snippets might break.
Maya Chen: Added changelog entry and merged. Thanks all! PR #834 merged by Maya Chen.
